review: Independent review of the P2 coverage/MCP preview fixes and approval reload recovery completed without new findings. The previously identified startup P1 remains open.
limits: Always-deny stub does not classify threats.
Live smoke uses builtin bash; child/MCP/partial API cases are covered by component tests, not a live remote MCP server.
Known OpenCode V1 limitations are documented in README.md.
Approval reload regression executes actual inline page JavaScript with a simulated browser environment; no automated real-browser reload test was run.
regressions_verified: Native availability fields and forged envelopes preserve valid coverage and real API errors.
Native availability fields reach classifier and user confirmation in both pre and post phases.
MCP extension output and numeric keys cannot replace actual content in the preview; immutable JSON retains all fields.
Structured MCP results and builtin attachments remain visible even with empty output.
Actual approval page JavaScript restores this tab's capability after reload and prefers a new URL capability.
Blocked, full or silently failing sessionStorage preserves the fragment for recovery.

known_open_findings.summary: If plugin initialization fails, OpenCode can continue without sensor hooks. Fixing this was outside the requested P2/reload scope.
